content.title: Rory McIlroy Masters 2026 score: Rory McIlroy tied after roller coaster round 3
content.text: Updated April 11, 2026, 7:22 p.m. ETRory McIlroy followed up a strong first round with a dominant second round at the 2026 Masters. The third round, well, it was a roller coaster that had the golfer battling for the lead all afternoonThe defending champ was poised to run away with his second consecutive green jacket. But a double bogey on 11 and a bogey on No. 12 drastically halted a historic run for McIlroy.McIlroy's 7-under par during Friday's second round was punctuated by birdies on six of his final seven holes, including the final four. It ran his score to 12 under for the tournament and gave him a commanding six-shot lead over Sam Burns and Patrick Reed. It was the largest 36-hole lead in Masters history.That's now gone as Young and McIlroy share the lead heading into Sunday.USA TODAY Sports followed Rory McIlroy's third round at the Masters with real-time scoring, leaderboard position and shot-by-shot updates and highlights: Rory McIlroy final score SaturdayIt wasn't pretty, but McIlroy did what he needed to do to stay on top and have a great shot of grabbing back-to-back green jackets on Sunday. He ends with a 1-over 73 and is tied with Cameron Young. Masters leaderboard live(Updated 7:20 p.m. ET)T1. Cameron Young: -11 (F)T1. Rory McIlroy -11 (F)3. Sam Burns: -10 (F)4. Shane Lowry: -9 (F)T5. Jason Day: -8 (F)T5. Justin Rose: -8 (F)T7. Haotong Li: -7 (F)T7. Scottie Scheffler: -7 (F) Rory McIlroy score (as of 6:50 p.m. ET)McIlroy is up and down but still very much the man to chase at the Masters, Through 17, he is now tied with Cameron Young at 11-under for the tournament. Rory McIlroy score (as of 6:25 p.m. ET)Staring at a great chance for eagle, McIlroy is content to grab back the lead with a birdie on No. 15. He is 12-under on the weekend. Rory McIlroy score (as of 6:12 p.m. ET)Welcome back, Rory. He gets a much-needed birdie on 13 to get back on top, sharing the lead with Cameron Young. Rory McIlroy score (as of 5:57 p.m. ET)McIlroy found himself in the pines again on 13. He punched out and then got his approach shot a little thin. He was still able to save par and remains one off the lead. Rory McIlroy score: Nightmare on second nine (as of 5:40 p.m. ET)Cameron Young takes the lead as Rorr McIlroy follows a double bogey on 11 with a bogey on No. 12. He is now one back of Young. Rory McIlroy score (as of 5:30 p.m. ET)A coupleo of nightmare holes took place. Cameron Young was fresh on the heels of McIlroy but found water on No. 15 then bogied. Then McIlroy also found the drink on No. 11, leading to a rare double bogey. McIlroy is still in the lead by one stroke at 11-under through 11. Rory McIlroy score (as of 5:12 p.m. ET)McIlroy is moving again on moving day. He nabs a birdie on No. 10 and is back to widening the lead and is 13-under through 10. Rory McIlroy score (as of 5:07 p.m. ET)McIlroy has a par in each of the last six holes. It's now onto the second nine as he stays 12-under. Rory McIlroy score (as of 4:45 p.m. ET)McIlroy is the epitome of consistency, no matter where he finds his drives. He is 12-under as the leaderboard continues to huddle together, just three strokes off his lead. Rory McIlroy score (as of 4:25 p.m. ET)Through seven and not much has changed. While the leaderboard closes in, McIlroy has not given an inch. He is 12-under (7). Rory McIlroy score (as of 4:20 p.m. ET)McIlroy's 2026 Masters has been characterized by how well he has dealt with less-than-stellar locations. He continues to prove that you don't need to hit that many fairways to stay in the lead. He is 12-under through six. Rory McIlroy score (as of 3:50 p.m. ET)McIlroy has shown some shaky strokes early on but continues to find ways to stay the course. After a bogey to start the round, he had a birdie on three and is now back to 12-under on the weekend. Rory McIlroy Masters score (-11 through two)McIlroy bogeyed the first hole of his third round on Saturday but followed with a par and is at 11-under as of 3:26 p.m. ET. Rory McIlroy score update, leaderboard spotMcIlroy bounced back from his opening bogey to score a par on the second hole, keeping him at 11-under overall. Meanwhile, Patrick Reed has opened his third round with three consecutive birdies and has slashed McIlroy's lead that began the day at six shots. Rory McIlroy Masters lead cut in halfMcIlroy entered Saturday with a six-shot lead, but that advantage is already down to three after he bogeyed the first hole of the third round. Patrick Reed is 8-under through two holes on Saturday, with Li Hoatong and Sam Burns at 7-under. Rory McIlroy Masters tee time todayMcIlroy and Sam Burns were the final pairing of the day, teeing off at 2:50 p.m. ET. Tommy Fleetwood -5Check out the full leaderboard. Back to back Masters winnersOnly three players have ever won the Masters two years in a row: Tiger Woods (2001-2002), Nick Faldo (1989-1990) and Jack Nicklaus (1965-1966).
